sponsorCtr.definition: Distinct matched impression IDs clicked / distinct impression IDs in the UTC window.

inquiryCompletion.definition: Started property/correlation sessions resolved without escalation / started sessions. Successful-inquiry proxy; no caller identity or first-call history.

latencySla.definition: Completed sessions with supplied fixture latency <1000ms / completed sessions with that latency source. Missing measurements excluded.
